items.title: Extreme cardiovascular risk as a major barrier to LDL-C target achievement: insights from ITACARE-P registry.
items.abstract: Achieving low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) targets remains challenging in secondary cardiovascular prevention despite the availability of effective lipid-lowering therapies. The 2025 ESC/EAS dyslipidaemia guidelines introduced an "extreme cardiovascular risk" category requiring LDL-C levels <40 mg/dL, potentially increasing the difficulty of target attainment. We aimed to identify clinical and therapeutic predictors of LDL-C target achievement according to the 2025 ESC/EAS recommendations and estimate the probability of goal attainment across different risk categories and treatment strategies. This sub-analysis of the multicentre ITACARE-P registry included 1904 outpatients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Missing data were handled using multiple imputation, and stable predictors were selected through Elastic Net regularization across 20 imputed datasets. A multivariable generalized linear mixed-effects model was internally validated using 1000 bootstrap resamples. Overall, 38% of patients achieved guideline-recommended LDL-C targets. Independent predictors of target attainment included PCSK9 inhibitor therapy (OR = 7.65), high-intensity statins (OR = 4.73), ezetimibe (OR = 2.64), male sex (OR = 1.99), diabetes mellitus (OR = 1.99), coronary artery disease (OR = 2.73), participation in cardiac rehabilitation (OR = 1.81), and high physical activity (O = 1.54). Current smoking, prior dyslipidaemia, and longer disease duration were associated with lower odds of achievement. Very-high-risk patients were more likely to achieve LDL-C targets than extreme-risk patients (OR = 5.66). Predicted target attainment ranged from 9.8% to 88.6% according to treatment intensity and risk category. Model discrimination was good (optimism-corrected AUC = 0.782). LDL-C target attainment under the 2025 ESC/EAS guidelines remains suboptimal, particularly among extreme-risk patients. Earlier therapeutic intensification and individualized lipid-lowering strategies may be necessary to improve real-world goal achievement.

items.title: Association of single nucleotide polymorphisms in lipid metabolism and vascular function genes with risk of cardiovascular disease.
items.abstract: Atherosclerosis progressively leads to cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Genetic variants in lipid and vascular related genes can impact cardiovascular health due to altered levels or functions of resulting proteins/enzymes. Therefore, we aimed to analyze the genetic variants in such genes in a cohort of Pakistani CVD patients. In this case-control study, 100 CVD patients and 50 healthy controls were sampled and their biochemical parameters were analyzed. Furthermore, five SNPs including; PCSK9 rs562556(G/A), APOE rs429358(T/C), FURIN rs4702(G/A), and rs6224(G/T), and TIE2/TEK rs1322052(T/C) were genotyped using in-house developed tetra-primer ARMS-PCR assays. Data were analyzed in SPSS and R programing. Genetic analyses showed that AA genotype frequency (69% vs. 46%) for rs562556, TT (19% vs. 4%) of rs6224 and TT (72% vs. 52%) of rs429358 were significantly higher in CVD patients relative to healthy controls. Logistic regression analysis revealed significant associations for rs429358 (OR = 0.17, p = 0.014) with CVD, whereas, other polymorphisms including rs562556 (OR = 0.32, p = 0.27), rs4702 (OR = 4.04, p = 0.21), and rs6224 (OR = 0.94, p = 0.85) were not significant after adjusting for the confounding factors (i.e. age, gender, BMI and smoking). Moreover, diastolic blood pressure, uric acid and urea were significantly different between CVD patients having genotypes: TC and TT for rs429358. Similarly, albumin levels were significantly higher in TC genotype carriers for rs1322052 SNP in CVD patients (p = 0.0001). Heterozygous genotype carriers of APOE rs429358 (TC) appeared to be protected from the development of CVD.

items.title: Structural basis of calcium-sensing receptor activation by extracellular modulators.
items.abstract: The calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) plays a central role in maintaining systemic calcium homeostasis. In the treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD), CaSR is targeted by calcimimetic drugs. Recent cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) studies have begun to reveal how CaSR is modulated by various allosteric modulators and signals through G proteins. However, the mechanisms of CaSR activation by the novel calcimimetic (upacicalcet) and the aminoglycoside antibiotic (neomycin) remain elusive. In this study, we present high-resolution cryo-EM structures of the human CaSR homodimer complexed with either upacicalcet or neomycin. Coupled with functional studies, our results reveal that both drugs target the extracellular region of the receptor. Upacicalcet occupies the amino acid-binding site of the Venus flytrap (VFT) domain, promoting VFT closure, whereas neomycin occupies a calcium-binding site at the homodimer interface at the base of the VFT, thus inducing the proximity of the two protomers. These findings reveal distinct molecular mechanisms of CaSR modulation by drug molecules, highlight the diversity of ligand-dependent regulatory modes, and provide a structural foundation for the rational design of future CaSR-targeting therapeutics. 钙敏感受体（calcium-sensing receptor，CaSR）在维持机体钙稳态中发挥核心作用。在慢性肾病（chronic kidney disease，CKD）相关的继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症（secondary hyperparathyroidism，SHPT）治疗中，CaSR是临床拟钙剂药物的作用靶点。近年来冷冻电镜研究揭示了CaSR受多种别构调控分子调节并偶联G蛋白的分子机理，但新型拟钙剂乌帕卡塞（upacicalcet）及氨基糖苷类抗生素新霉素（neomycin）介导CaSR激活的分子机制仍是未知。本研究解析了人源CaSR同源二聚体在激活状态下与乌帕卡塞或新霉素结合的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构。结合功能学实验发现，这两种药物均靶向受体的细胞外结构域:乌帕卡塞占据捕蝇草结构域（Venus flytrap，VFT）的氨基酸结合位点并促进VFT闭合;而新霉素占据位于VFT底部同源二聚体界面处的一个钙离子结合位点，诱导两个原聚体相互靠近。上述结果揭示了药物分子调控CaSR的两种不同分子机制，凸显了配体依赖的多样化调控模式，为未来CaSR靶向治疗药物的理性设计提供了结构基础。.

items.title: Structure-guided development of G protein-biased apelin receptor agonists for cardiovascular disease.
items.abstract: Apelin receptor (APLNR) is a crucial G protein-coupled receptor that plays a central role in cardiovascular homeostasis; therefore, it represents a promising therapeutic target for heart failure, myocardial infarction, cardiac hypertrophy, and pulmonary arterial hypertension. However, the activation of APLNR simultaneously engages inhibitory G protein (G i )-mediated protective signaling and β-arrestin pathways that are associated with pathological cardiac remodeling, thereby imposing significant limitations and challenges for the therapeutic development of conventional balanced agonists. Recent advances in structural biology and pharmacology have provided valuable mechanistic insights into receptor activation and biased signaling. High-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures revealed the conformational basis of signal bias, enabling the rational design of fully G protein-biased agonists that retain cardiovascular benefits while avoiding hypertrophic effects. This review summarizes recent progress in APLNR signaling mechanisms and biased ligand development, highlighting a number of emerging strategies for the precision pharmacological targeting of this receptor. Apelin受体（APLNR）是一种重要的G蛋白偶联受体，在维持心血管稳态中发挥关键作用，是心力衰竭、心肌梗死、心肌肥厚和肺动脉高压等心血管疾病的潜在治疗靶点。然而，APLNR激活后既可启动具有心血管保护作用的抑制型G蛋白（G i ）介导信号通路，也可激活与病理性心脏重构相关的β-arrestin信号通路。这种复杂的信号转导特征给传统平衡型激动剂的临床转化带来了显著挑战。近年来，结构生物学与药理学的快速发展为阐明APLNR的受体激活机制和偏向性信号转导提供了重要的结构与理论基础。高分辨率冷冻电镜结构进一步揭示了APLNR信号偏向性的构象基础，为合理设计选择性激活G蛋白信号通路的偏向性激动剂提供了可能。这类激动剂有望在保留心血管保护作用的同时，避免由β-arrestin信号通路介导的心肌肥厚效应。本文综述APLNR信号转导机制及偏向性配体研发的最新进展，并重点讨论精准靶向APLNR的潜在药物设计策略及其在心血管疾病治疗中的应用前景。.

items.title: [Effect of mycophenolate mofetil on in-stent restenosis after percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with autoimmune hepatitis and overlap syndrome complicated with coronary heart disease].
items.abstract: Objective: To investigate the effect of mycophenolate mofetil on in-stent restenosis (ISR) after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) and overlap syndrome complicated with coronary heart disease. Methods: Patients with autoimmune liver diseases (AILD) [including AIH, primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC), and overlap syndrome] complicated with coronary heart disease who underwent PCI at Tianjin Medical University Second Hospital between January 2019 and December 2025 were retrospectively enrolled, they were divided into mycophenolate mofetil group and non-mycophenolate mofetil group according to postoperative use of mycophenolate mofetil, and followed up until March 31, 2026 to compare the baseline characteristics of the two groups of patients. Firth penalized likelihood-corrected Cox regression models and Fine-Gray competing risk models (with all-cause death as the competing event) were used to evaluate the association between mycophenolate mofetil use and ISR after PCI in patients with AIH and overlap syndrome complicated with coronary heart disease (because few patients with PBC and PSC received mycophenolate mofetil, this analysis only included patients with AIH and overlap syndrome). The Benjamini-Hochberg method was applied for multiple comparison correction to calculate the FDR q values. A 1∶1 propensity score matching (PSM) was employed to balance baseline characteristics between the two groups. Kaplan-Meier method was used to plot survival curves to compare the ISR-free survival rates. Sensitivity analysis was performed on all AILD patients to validate the robustness of the results. Results: A total of 172 patients with AILD complicated with coronary heart disease were enrolled, including 48 cases (27.9%) in the mycophenolate mofetil group and 124 cases (72.1%) in the non-mycophenolate mofetil group. The follow-up duration [ M ( Q 1 , Q 3 )] was 13 (7, 16) and 10 (5, 16) months respectively. The proportion of patients with hyperlipidemia [12.5% (6/48) vs 32.3% (40/124), P =0.009] and diabetes mellitus [8.3% (4/48) vs 27.4% (34/124), P =0.007] were lower in the mycophenolate mofetil group than that in the non-mycophenolate mofetil group, while the proportion of patients with high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)>0.8 mg/L [47.9% (23/48) vs 27.4% (34/124), P =0.010], previous use of prednisone [79.2% (38/48) vs 22.6% (28/124), P P P =0.002] and immunoglobulin G (IgG) [19.6 (15.0, 26.0) vs 15.2 (14.0, 16.8) g/L, P =0.006] were higher in the mycophenolate mofetil group. Among 100 patients with AIH and overlap syndrome (82 and 18 cases, respectively), mycophenolate mofetil use was associated with a reduced risk of ISR in both Firth-corrected Cox regression model and competing risk model (Firth-corrected Cox model: HR =0.17, 95% CI : 0.04-0.51, FDR q =0.004; competing risk model: sHR =0.14, 95% CI : 0.05-0.43, FDR q =0.003). After PSM (40 cases in each group), there was no statistically significant difference in all covariates between the two groups (all SMD P HR =0.29, 95% CI : 0.09-0.73, FDR q =0.030; competing risk model: sHR =0.26, 95% CI : 0.10-0.72, FDR q =0.022). Conclusion: Mycophenolate mofetil use is associated with a reduced risk of ISR after PCI in patients with AIH and overlap syndrome complicated with coronary heart disease. 目的： 探讨霉酚酸酯对自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）及重叠综合征合并冠心病患者经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）术后支架内再狭窄（ISR）的影响。 方法： 回顾性纳入2019年1月至2025年12月于天津医科大学第二医院行PCI治疗的自身免疫性肝病（AILD）［包括AIH、原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）、原发性硬化性胆管炎（PSC）及重叠综合征］合并冠心病患者，根据术后是否应用霉酚酸酯分为霉酚酸酯组和非霉酚酸酯组，随访至2026年3月31日，比较两组患者基线特征。采用Firth惩罚似然校正的Cox回归模型和Fine-Gray竞争性风险模型（以全因死亡为竞争事件）评估应用霉酚酸酯与AIH及重叠综合征合并冠心病患者PCI术后ISR的关系（因PBC及PSC患者中应用霉酚酸酯者较少，本分析仅纳入AIH及重叠综合征患者）。采用Benjamini-Hochberg法进行多重比较校正，计算FDR q 值。采用1∶1倾向性评分匹配（PSM）均衡霉酚酸酯组和非霉酚酸酯组基线特征。采用Kaplan-Meier法绘制生存曲线，比较两组无ISR生存率。纳入全部AILD患者进行敏感性分析以验证结果稳健性。 结果： 共纳入172例AILD合并冠心病的患者，霉酚酸酯组48例（27.9%），非霉酚酸酯组124例（72.1%），两组随访时间［ M （ Q 1 ， Q 3 ）］分别为13（7，16）和10（5，16）个月。霉酚酸酯组高脂血症［12.5%（6/48）比32.3%（40/124）， P =0.009］和糖尿病［8.3%（4/48）比27.4%（34/124）， P =0.007］患者比例低于非霉酚酸酯组；超敏C反应蛋白（hs-CRP）>0.8 mg/L［47.9%（23/48）比27.4%（34/124）， P =0.010］、既往使用泼尼松［79.2%（38/48）比22.6%（28/124）， P P P =0.002］和免疫球蛋白G（IgG）［19.6（15.0，26.0）比15.2（14.0，16.8）g/L， P =0.006］水平高于非霉酚酸酯组。AIH及重叠综合征患者共100例（分别有82和18例），其Firth校正的Cox回归模型和竞争性风险模型中，应用霉酚酸酯与AIH及重叠综合征患者PCI术后ISR风险降低相关（Firth校正Cox模型： HR =0.17，95% CI ：0.04~0.51，FDR q =0.004；竞争性风险模型： sHR =0.14，95% CI ：0.05~0.43，FDR q =0.003）。PSM匹配后（每组40例），霉酚酸酯组和非霉酚酸酯组所有协变量的差异均无统计学意义（均 SMD P HR =0.29，95% CI ：0.09~0.73，FDR q =0.030；竞争风险模型： sHR =0.26，95% CI ：0.10~0.72，FDR q =0.022）。 结论： 应用霉酚酸酯与AIH及重叠综合征合并冠心病患者PCI术后ISR风险降低相关。.

items.title: Roles of macrophages in tumor immunotherapy: metabolism, immune checkpoints, and combination strategies.
items.abstract: Macrophages influence anti-tumor immunity through tractable metabolic and checkpoint programs. Within hypoxic, nutrient-competitive tumor beds, tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) adopt oxidative and lipid-based metabolisms, dampening antigen presentation and T-cell support. Converging evidence shows that lactate flux, fatty acid oxidation (FAO), and glutamine handling steer TAMs toward immunosuppressive states that blunt checkpoint efficacy. Here, we synthesize the mechanism by which discrete pathways-glycolysis/pentose phosphate pathway (PPP) switching, FAO-lysosomal lipolysis, and glutamine-α-ketoglutarate signaling-mechanistically reprogram TAMs. We then map these circuits onto combination strategies involving programmed cell death (ligand) protein 1/cytotoxic T-lymphocyte antigen-4 (PD-(L)1/CTLA-4) blockade, chemotherapy/radiotherapy, and chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T). Rather than providing a catalogue, we emphasize when metabolic rewiring dominates, which TAM subsets are affected, and how these levers can be timed or co-inhibited to restore cytotoxic T-cell function. This approach provides operational guidance for pairing macrophage-directed agents with immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumors. 巨噬细胞通过可调控的代谢程序和免疫检查点途径影响抗肿瘤免疫。在缺氧且营养竞争激烈的肿瘤环境中，肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）往往采取以氧化和脂质为主的代谢方式，从而削弱抗原递呈和对T细胞的支持。越来越多的证据表明，乳酸通量、脂肪酸氧化（FAO）以及谷氨酰胺代谢途径能够驱动TAMs向免疫抑制性状态转化，进而削弱免疫检查点治疗的效果。本文综合梳理了几条关键代谢通路——糖酵解/磷酸戊糖途径的切换、FAO-溶酶体脂解、谷氨酰胺-α-酮戊二酸信号——如何在机制上重塑TAM功能，并进一步将这些代谢环路与多种联合治疗策略进行对接，包括程序性细胞死亡（配体）蛋白1/细胞毒性T淋巴细胞抗原4（PD-(L)1/CTLA-4）阻断、放化疗以及嵌合抗原受体T细胞免疫（CAR-T）疗法。与其提供单纯的研究目录，我们更强调:在何种情况下代谢重编程处于主导地位、涉及哪些TAM亚群，以及如何把握这些杠杆点或进行联合抑制，以恢复细胞毒性T细胞的功能。此种框架为将巨噬细胞靶向药物与免疫检查点抑制剂在实体瘤中合理配伍提供了操作指导。.

items.title: [Evolution of later-line treatment strategies for advanced colorectal cancer: seeking balance between survival benefit and quality of life].
items.abstract: Later-line treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) has shifted from purely pursuing survival prolongation to a chronic disease management model that balances survival with quality of life (QoL). Conventional line-by-line drug sequencing faces efficacy plateaus and tolerability challenges, necessitating an integrated precision framework combining biological stratification, dynamic monitoring, and multimodal therapy. This review synthesizes four evolving domains in later-line management. In systemic therapy, cross-line use of antiangiogenic agents (bevacizumab, anlotinib), trifluridine/tipiracil combination regimens, immunotherapy breakthroughs in MSI-H/dMMR populations, and targeted rechallenge strategies have demonstrated clinical value. Locoregional therapy integration offers salvage options for oligometastatic patients through selective internal radiation therapy (SIRT) of liver metastases, pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC), and stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT). Precision stratification builds an end-to-end care pathway via circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) trajectory monitoring, body composition assessment, and molecular biomarkers. Special population management addresses individualized considerations for elderly frail patients and early-onset colorectal cancer. The review emphasizes that treatment decisions must balance survival benefit against toxicity burden, prioritizing patient-reported outcomes (PROs), toxicity management, and early integration of palliative support. Future paradigms should establish patient-centered, multidisciplinary continuum-of-care systems that coordinate three pillars: precision molecular profiling to guide therapy selection, rational de-escalation to avoid overtreatment, and supportive care to preserve dignity throughout the disease trajectory. 晚期结直肠癌的后线治疗已从单纯追求生存延长，转向生存获益与生活质量并重的慢性病管理模式。传统“按线数换药”的序贯策略面临疗效趋于平台期与患者耐受性下降的双重挑战，后线治疗亟需构建融合生物学分层、动态监测与多模式干预的精准诊疗体系。本文围绕后线治疗的四大演进方向展开综述。在系统性药物治疗层面，抗血管生成药物的跨线应用（贝伐珠单抗、安罗替尼）、曲氟尿苷/替匹嘧啶联合方案、免疫治疗在微卫星高度不稳定/错配修复缺陷人群中的突破以及靶向治疗再挑战策略，均已显示出明确的临床价值。在局部治疗整合方面，肝脏选择性内放射治疗、腹腔加压气溶胶化疗及立体定向放疗为寡转移患者提供了重要的挽救性治疗选择。在精准分层策略层面，基于循环肿瘤DNA动态监测、身体组分评估及多维度分子标志物的全链条诊疗体系，正推动后线治疗从经验性决策向生物学导向的个体化决策转变。在特殊人群管理方面，针对老年衰弱患者与早发性结直肠癌分别提出了差异化的个体治疗考量。后线治疗决策须在生存获益与毒性负担之间审慎权衡，重视患者报告结局的预后与决策价值、治疗相关毒性的全程管理以及姑息支持的早期介入。未来应构建以患者为中心、多学科协作的全病程管理体系，以精准分子分型指导方案选择，以理性的“减法策略”避免过度治疗，以高质量的支持治疗保障患者尊严，三者协同实现生存延长与生活质量的最优平衡。.
items.journal: Zhonghua wei chang wai ke za zhi = Chinese journal of gastrointestinal surgery

items.title: [Trends in the treatment of obesity: from single modality to combination therapy].
items.abstract: The medical treatment of obesity includes pharmacotherapy, interventional therapy with medical devices, and metabolic and bariatric surgery. With the advancement in understanding of obesity and its treatment goals, the combined application of multiple therapeutic modalities-particularly the combination of bariatric surgery and pharmacotherapy based on a foundation of healthy lifestyle and behavioral management for severe and extreme obesity-represents an effective future solution. This includes the use of anti-obesity medications before bariatric surgery to reduce surgical difficulty and perioperative risks, and the use of anti-obesity medications as adjunctive therapy after bariatric surgery to further improve both short- and long-term treatment outcomes. However, specific combination regimens, including the timing of medication initiation, drug selection, and duration of treatment, await further clinical investigation. Targeted therapy and immunotherapy for obesity should be future research hotspots and hold promise as breakthrough points in the clinical management of obesity. 肥胖症的医学治疗包括减重药物治疗、医疗器械介入治疗和外科减重手术治疗。随着对肥胖症的不断深入认识，以及治疗目标的进一步提高，多种治疗手段联合应用、尤其是对于重度和极重度肥胖症的基于健康生活方式和行为管理基础之上的减重手术与药物联用方案，包括减重手术前应用减重药物以降低减重手术难度及围手术期风险、减重手术后应用减重药物辅助治疗以进一步提高肥胖症近、远期治疗结局等，是未来有效的解决方案，然而具体的联合方案，包括药物治疗启动时机、药物选择、治疗时长等，均有待进一步临床研究。肥胖症的靶向治疗和免疫治疗，应是未来研究的热点，并有望成为肥胖症临床治疗的突破点。.

items.title: [Efficacy of immunotherapy combined with anti-angiogenesis therapy in patients with advanced NSCLC and identification of prognostic biomarkers].
items.abstract: Objective: To explore the potential efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) combined with anti-angiogenic therapy as second- or third-line treatment for advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in a real-world setting, and to identify predictive and prognostic biomarkers. Methods: We collected clinicopathological data of patients with advanced NSCLC who received either immunotherapy alone (monotherapy group) or immunotherapy combined with anti-angiogenic therapy (combination group) at Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute & Hospital between January 2019 and January 2023, and performed propensity score matching (PSM). Survival analysis was conducted using multivariate Cox regression analysis. Multiplex immunofluorescence staining was employed to explore the relationships among short-term efficacy, prognosis, and the tumor microenvironment. Results: After PSM, a total of 140 NSCLC patients were included. The median progression-free survival (mPFS) in the combination group was 6.9 months, which was 2.3 months longer than that in the monotherapy group (4.6 months, P =0.003). There was no significant difference in overall survival (OS) between the two groups (21.3 vs. 20.9 months, P =0.973). In patients with low lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) ≤230.5 U/L and a lung immune prognosis index (LIPI) of 0, combination therapy significantly prolonged the PFS (7.9 vs. 12.8 months, P ＜0.001; 8.6 vs. 13.6 months, P =0.005) and OS (22.5 vs. 34.0 months, P =0.013; 22.5 vs. 30.9 months, P =0.018). PD-L1 expression was correlated with OS in both the monotherapy and combination groups (both P ＜0.05). Multivariate analysis identified clinical stage ( HR= 2.067, 95% CI : 1.322, 3.232, P =0.001), Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score ( HR= 3.785, 95% CI : 2.307, 6.211, P ＜0.001), and LIPI ( HR= 2.737, 95% CI : 1.618, 4.630, P ＜0.001) as independent predictors of PFS. In the combination group, LDH and LIPI were both associated with PFS and OS (all P ＜0.05). Multiple immunofluorescence staining confirmed that patients with a FOXP3 + T-cell count > 90 per high-power field had shorter PFS (2.7 vs. 8.4 months, P =0.031) and a trend toward shorter OS (18.7 vs. 25.8 months, P =0.080). Conclusions: Immunotherapy combined with anti-angiogenic therapy can prolong PFS. LDH and LIPI are expected to serve as non-invasive, dynamically monitorable biomarkers for identifying the population most likely to benefit from combination therapy and for predicting short-term efficacy and prognosis. 目的： 探索真实世界中免疫检查点抑制剂联合抗血管生成治疗作为晚期经治非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）二三线治疗的潜在疗效，并探索疗效预测和预后的生物标志物。 方法： 收集2019年1月至2023年1月间天津医科大学肿瘤医院接受单免疫治疗（单药组）或免疫联合抗血管生成治疗（联合组）的晚期NSCLC患者的临床病理资料，并进行倾向评分匹配（PSM）。生存分析采用Kaplan-Meier法，影响因素分析采用多因素Cox回归分析，采用多重免疫荧光染色技术分析近期疗效、预后与肿瘤微环境之间的关系。 结果： PSM后，共纳入140例NSCLC患者。联合组的中位无进展生存时间（PFS，6.9个月）较单药组延长2.3个月（4.6个月， P =0.003）。两组间总生存时间（OS）差异无统计学意义（单药组和联合组中位OS分别为21.3和20.9个月， P =0.628）。在低乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）≤230.5 U/L及肺免疫预后指数（LIPI）=0的患者中，联合治疗可以显著延长患者的PFS（中位PFS 7.9和12.8个月， P ＜0.001；8.6和13.6个月， P =0.005）及OS（中位OS 22.5和34.0个月， P =0.013；22.5和30.9个月， P =0.018）。单药组和联合组患者中，程序性死亡受体配体1表达均与OS有关（均 P ＜0.05）。多因素分析结果显示，TNM分期（ HR =2.067，95% CI ：1.322～3.232， P =0.001）、美国东部肿瘤协作组体能状态评分（ HR =3.785，95% CI ：2.307～6.211， P ＜0.001）和LIPI（ HR =2.737，95% CI ：1.618～4.630， P ＜0.001）是PFS的独立预测因素。联合组中，LDH和LIPI与PFS及OS均相关（均 P ＜0.05）。多重免疫荧光染色证实，FOXP3 + T细胞计数＞90个/高倍视野的患者PFS更短（中位PFS 2.7和8.4个月， P =0.031），并且OS也有缩短趋势（中位OS 18.7和25.8个月， P =0.080）。 结论： 免疫联合抗血管生成治疗可延长PFS，LDH和LIPI有望成为筛选联合治疗优势人群并判断近期疗效及预后且无创、可动态监测的生物标志物。.

items.title: [Inclusion body myositis with Sjögren disease and M-proteinemia: a case report and literature review].
items.abstract: We report a case of inclusion body myositis complicated by Sjögren disease (SjD) and M-proteinemia, in which glucocorticoid (GC) administration resulted in M-protein disappearance and improved muscle strength. A 62-year-old woman presented with a 5-year history of dry mouth and eyes, and a 3-month history of bilateral lower limb muscle weakness as her chief complaint. Weakness was noted in the iliopsoas and deep finger flexor muscles. A muscle biopsy led to a diagnosis of inclusion body myositis, with concomitant SjD and M-proteinemia. Following GC administration, the M-protein disappeared and muscle strength improved. The M-protein in this case was considered benign M-proteinemia caused by an excessive immune response. This case suggests that immunotherapy may be effective in inclusion body myositis, which has a strong immune-mediated component.

items.title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Chronic Hepatitis B.
items.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at-risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.

items.title: Single-molecule and long-read sequencing reveals structural diversity of hepatitis B virus haplotypes including mutations, deletions, and splicing.
items.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) exhibits diverse pathological states during chronic infection. While defective genomes with deletions and splicing have been sporadically reported, the quasispecies structure and their role in disease progression have remained unclear due to technical constraints of conventional short-read sequencing. Using rolling circle amplification (RCA)-nanopore long-read sequencing, we analyzed near full-length HBV genomes (approximately 3.2kb) at the single-molecule level from 6 serum samples obtained from 5 patients. Haplotypes were reconstructed from reads with point mutations, and structural linkages with deletions and splicing were evaluated. Diverse haplotypes (three to five per patient) involving mutations across the HBV genome, predominantly in putative immune-targeted regions (core, preS, and surface), were detected in all cases, along with variants containing different deletions and splicing patterns. Notably, in chronic hepatitis and hepatocellular carcinoma cases, a substantial portion (29.5-71.3%) of circulating HBV DNA consisted of deletion and splicing variants, which clustered significantly in specific haplotypes (p < 2.8 × 10⁻⁵). Longitudinal changes in haplotype composition involving point mutations and different deletion/splicing patterns were observed in one patient before and after HBeAg seroconversion. HBV exists as a population comprising multiple haplotypes with mutations, deletions, and splicing interconnected and dynamically changing according to disease state. Monitoring circulating splicing variants and haplotype dynamics may serve as novel biomarkers for disease understanding. This single-molecule long-read analysis elucidates the molecular basis of HBV quasispecies evolution.

items.title: Androgen receptor signaling in hepatocellular carcinoma: mechanisms of male predominance and therapeutic opportunities.
items.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is two to four times more common in men than in women. The sex distribution of viral hepatitis, alcohol use and adiposity explains only part of this difference, which points to sex-specific host biology as a further driver. The androgen receptor (AR), a ligand-activated transcription factor expressed in hepatocytes and in most HCC, is a strong candidate: both epidemiologic and experimental data implicate it in the male excess. This review draws that evidence together. Prospective cohorts link higher circulating testosterone and sex hormone-binding globulin to liver cancer risk, although raising SHBG experimentally suppresses rather than promotes hepatocarcinogenesis, a discordance that bears on how those associations should be read, and experimental studies group the underlying biology into several modules: constitutively active AR and its splice variants, kinase-driven phosphorylation of the receptor, downstream effectors of proliferation, invasion and angiogenesis, non-coding RNA circuits, androgen-metabolizing enzymes and the systemic endocrine axis, and the effect of androgen on the tumor immune microenvironment. The weight of each module differs across hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related, hepatitis C virus (HCV)-related, metabolic dysfunction-associated and anabolic steroid-induced disease. Therapeutic work remains largely preclinical and has centered on AR antagonists combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors or immune checkpoint blockade, on degraders aimed at AR splice variants, on proteolysis-targeting chimeras and nucleic-acid approaches that eliminate ligand-independent receptor states, and on enzyme inhibitors. Two problems still limit translation: AR appears oncogenic in most settings but tumor-suppressive in some, and androgen suppresses antitumor immunity in certain contexts while enhancing it in others. Clarifying when each holds is what will determine whether AR-directed therapy, already established in prostate cancer, can be extended to liver cancer.

items.title: Diagnosed Dental Diseases, Tooth Loss and the Risk of Primary Liver Cancer in a Nationwide Swedish Cohort.
items.abstract: Poor dental health has been shown to increase the risk of several types of cancer, but its association with primary liver cancer (PLC) remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the association between dental diseases, tooth loss and the risk of PLC. We conducted a large population-based retrospective cohort study including 5,893,325 adults registered in the Swedish Dental Health Register between 2009 and 2016. Participants were linked to multiple Swedish national registers to ascertain incident PLC cases. Cox regression analyses were performed to evaluate the association between dental diseases, tooth loss and the risk of PLC, using attained age as the timescale and adjusting for potential confounders. Additionally, in a sibling comparison analysis we controlled for shared genetic and early-life environmental factors. During a mean follow-up of 6.36 years, 2374 PLC cases were identified through linkage with the Cancer Register: 1856 hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and 518 non-HCC PLC cases. Both caries (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.15, 95% CI: 1.02-1.30) and periodontitis (HR = 1.25, 95% CI: 1.12-1.39) were associated with an increased risk of PLC. Further, a clear dose-response relationship was observed between fewer remaining teeth and PLC risk, with HRs ranging from 1.15 to 1.84 (p   27 remaining teeth. Subtype-specific analyses showed that caries was associated with non-HCC PLC, whereas periodontitis was associated with HCC. Tooth loss was more strongly associated with HCC than with non-HCC PLC. The overall findings were generally consistent across sibling-controlled, subgroup, and sensitivity analyses. Our large population-based cohort study suggests that caries, periodontitis and tooth loss are associated with an elevated risk of PLC, with distinct patterns of association observed for HCC and non-HCC PLC.

items.title: [Organ-preserving hemipelvic exenteration for low locally advanced rectal cancer].
items.abstract: Objective: To investigate the safety and clinical feasibility of hemi-pelvectomy in the treatment of low locally advanced rectal cancer. Methods: The surgical procedure comprised the following steps: (1) Laparoscopic exploration: no gross abnormalities were observed in the abdominopelvic peritoneum, liver, gallbladder, stomach, small intestine, or mesentery. (2) Open surgery: via the Marcille triangle approach, sequential resections were performed, including lateral pelvic wall resection, presacral dissection, pelvic floor resection, and intrapelvic lesion excision. En bloc resection encompassed the "low rectum + uterus/cervix + left hemipelvis (complete resection of the pelvic plexus nerves, with preservation of the left superior vesical artery and left S1-S5 nerve roots) + anterior S3/S4 presacral tissue," while the right pelvic plexus nerves were completely preserved. (3) Tissue reconstruction and pelvic wound closure: a modified Bacon procedure was employed for digestive tract reconstruction, a pedicled omental flap was used to isolate the anastomotic sites, and a biological mesh was applied to separate the abdominopelvic cavity. (4) Second-stage surgery: the prolapsed bowel segment was resected one month postoperatively.A retrospective analysis was performed on the clinical data (including the intra- and postoperative, and follow-up outcomes of the patients) of a 25-year-old female patient with low locally advanced rectal cancer who underwent hemi-pelvectomy at the Department of Colorectal Surgery, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Naval Medical University in November 2024. Results: The patient underwent an uneventful operation, with an operative time of approximately 6.5 hours and an estimated blood loss of approximately 400 ml. No intraoperative blood transfusion was required, and the patient returned safely to the general ward postoperatively. Postoperative pathology confirmed R0 resection, and no additional adjuvant chemoradiotherapy was administered. Postoperative recovery was favorable, with no severe complications such as abdominopelvic infection, empty pelvis syndrome (EPS), or intestinal obstruction. A second-stage operation was performed at 1 month postoperatively to resect the prolapsed bowel. At 6 months postoperatively, bladder function was normal, the Williams anal function score was grade B, and the quality-of-life score returned to the preoperative baseline. At 12 months postoperatively, the patient had 1-4 bowel movements per day and reported good satisfaction. At 18 months postoperatively, molecular residual disease (MRD) testing remained persistently negative, with no evidence of local recurrence. Conclusion: This preliminary experience suggests that hemi-pelvectomy for low locally advanced rectal cancer demonstrates acceptable clinical feasibility and safety. 目的： 探讨半盆廓清术治疗低位局部晚期直肠癌的安全性及临床可行性。 方法： 手术流程：（1）腹腔镜探查：腹盆腔腹膜、肝脏、胆囊、胃、小肠及系膜等处未见明显异常；（2）开腹手术：自马歇尔三角入路，依次行侧盆切除-骶前铲除-盆底切除-骨盆腔内病灶切除，整块切除“低位直肠+子宫/宫颈+左侧盆（盆丛神经完全切除，保留左膀胱上动脉、左骶1-5神经）+骶3/4前组织”，完整保留右侧盆丛神经；（3）组织重建及盆腔创面封闭：改良Bacon术重建消化系统，带蒂大网膜瓣隔离各吻合口，生物补片隔离腹盆腔；（4）二期手术：术后1个月切除脱出肠管。回顾性总结海军军医大学第二附属医院肛肠外科于2024年11月应用半盆廓清术治疗的1例25岁女性低位局部晚期直肠癌患者的临床资料，分析患者术中、术后及随访情况。 结果： 患者手术顺利，手术时间约6.5 h，出血量约400 ml，术中未输血，术后安全返回普通病房。术后病理证实R 0 切除，术后未追加辅助放化疗。术后恢复良好，无腹盆腔感染、空盆腔综合征、肠梗阻等严重并发症。术后1个月行二期手术切除脱出肠管。术后6个月膀胱功能正常，Williams肛门功能评分B级，生活质量评分回归术前基线水平。术后12个月，排便1~4次/d，患者满意度良好，术后18个月分子残留病灶检测持续阴性，无局部复发证据。 结论： 半盆廓清术治疗低位局部晚期直肠癌具备一定临床可行性和安全性。.

items.title: Role of Gut Microbiota-derived Metabolites in the Pathogenesis and Progression of Metabolic Dysfunction-associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD): A Systematic Review.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is closely linked with significant comorbidities and mortality. Evidence suggests that gut microbiota-derived metabolites play a vital role in the initiation and progression of MASLD. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the role of these metabolites in the pathogenesis and progression of MASLD, including steatosis, steatohepatitis, fibrosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting of Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines. A systematic literature search was conducted across PubMed/Medline, Embase, Web of Science, and Scopus from inception to December 2025. Eligible studies included observational, interventional, animal, and in vitro mechanistic studies. Human observational studies were evaluated using the Newcastle-Ottawa scale, randomized controlled trials using the Cochrane risk of bias-2 (ROB-2) tool, and in vitro studies using a qualitative mechanistic approach. The risk of bias was assessed using the Systematic Review Centre for Laboratory Animal Experimentation (SYRCLE) tool for animal studies. Results were synthesized narratively due to heterogeneity in the data. This study was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261293786). A total of 28 studies were included. Alterations in bile acids, ethanol, fatty acids, and other compounds, such as indole derivatives, were associated with fibrosis, steatosis, steatohepatitis, and HCC. Bile acid levels vary with disease stage, while ethanol was reported to be generally high across studies. Different short-chain fatty acids have various roles in MASLD pathogenesis. Indole derivatives are capable of attenuating hepatic steatosis and inflammation. Altering the gut microbiota is also known to play a vital role in reducing the progression of liver cancer. The gut microbiota-derived metabolites, particularly conjugated bile acids and endogenous ethanol, are highly promising and may play a fundamental role in the development and progression of MASLD, including steatosis, steatohepatitis, fibrosis, and HCC. Further high-quality, well-designed studies in humans are warranted to evaluate their precise role and validate their use in routine clinical practice.
